central_message: CM identity and within-stage maturation are separate axes; no two-context cluster restriction
Known FB and EC subtypes are analyzed around each CM identity and maturation group; unsupported cells are gray
Subtype associations can be CM-state- and component-specific; local models and source/geometry sensitivity limit causal interpretation
Reviewed fibroblast programs and candidate RNA continuity provide a temporal counterpart to subtype-resolved neighborhoods
Transport is conditioned on known CM identity; fine source descriptors and held-out maturation are audited rather than collapsed into broad contexts
Known CM identities, within-stage maturation and specific FB/EC subtypes define the developmental questions and follow-up experiments
